boundary: Proposed 2026.10.15.1 successor has no accepted artifact. Prior 2026.10.13.3 producer is historical and NOT evidence of testing on physical iOS/iPadOS and Android devices. Physical install, audible speech, offline/reboot, atomic update, low-storage, accessibility zoom and return focus are PENDING. Real assistive-technology evidence is separately governed by data/accessibility-real-at-validation-v1.json. Physical-device automation cannot substitute for actual named human/device observations. Signing, provider and machine-control authority remain HOLD.
privacyBoundary: Public contract metadata must not include learner names, customer/site identifiers, email addresses, private screenshots, raw process data, backup content, filesystem/user paths or other personal/proprietary evidence. Keep detailed device evidence outside the public repository and reference it only with a non-sensitive review identifier.
